Market today: European debt fears are spooking markets, especially impacting global currencies and stocks. This is the real driver, and it's bad news for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: CRWD (29.99%) and QQQ (-0.68%) are flagged for attention. SMH (-15.18%), SMCI (-27.92%), SNOW (-8.3%), MU (-34.55%), SOXL (-58.32%), and SPAL (-37.46%) are all showing significant losses and are marked SELL.

Watch: Keep an eye on the leveraged ETFs like SOXL and SPAL. Their decay and volatility are amplified by your margin.

Bottom line: European debt fears are the primary concern, and your concentrated, leveraged tech holdings are vulnerable.
plays: Trim QQQI if it breaks below 52.
Consider trimming SMCI if it breaks below its stop at 37.3.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
